explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/785: Narkiewicz proved that for exact additive complements, after possibly swapping, A(2x)/A(x) → 1 and B(2x)/B(x) → 2. The statement is the disjunction of the two orderings. Division by counting values that are 0 for small x is harmless, since A and B are infinite. Faithful.
